Q.FullSourceCutoff.both_tests_smooth_source_trace_of_cost.{w} (K : Type w) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  {κ : Type w} (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) (Lambda epsilon C : ℝ)
  (hlocal :
    Masullo.NuclearFactorization.HasNuclearCost
      ((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯).comp
        (KPhysicalMask.smoothMaskCLM K mu Lambda epsilon))
      C) :
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E := Q.FullSourceCutoff.fullFiniteSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have P := 1 - (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have M := KPhysicalMask.smoothMaskCLM K mu Lambda epsilon;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      Integrable (fun x => FSmoothCutoff.mask K Lambda epsilon x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x) mu) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto
        (fun T =>
          Masullo.NuclearFactorization.nuclearNorm ((P.comp A).comp M - ((1 - (E T).starProjection).comp A).comp M))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun T =>
          Masullo.TraceClass.trace (A.comp M) -
            ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
              FSmoothCutoff.mask K Lambda epsilon x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu)
        Filter.atTop (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((P.comp A).comp M)))
